tools.name: company.context
tools.description: Return organization/company/department/manager context for the current OpenClaw agent.

tools.name: company.tasks.list
tools.description: List business tasks assigned to the current agent.

tools.name: company.task.status
tools.description: Update status of an assigned Company task.

tools.name: company.knowledge.search
tools.description: Search permitted Company knowledge using vector search.

tools.name: company.approval.request
tools.description: Evaluate policy and create an approval request when required.

tools.name: company.message.owner
tools.description: Escalate an agent message to its manager/owner inbox.

tools.name: company.artifact.create
tools.description: Register source code, files or deliverables with immutable version/checksum metadata.

tools.name: company.artifact.list
tools.description: List artifacts available in the current organization/bundle/task scope.

tools.name: company.artifact.handoff
tools.description: Hand an exact artifact version to another member/agent for review, continuation or commit.

tools.name: company.handoffs.list
tools.description: Read pending artifact handoffs for a member/agent.

tools.name: company.agent.message
tools.description: Send a persistent internal message to another member/agent.

tools.name: company.events.emit
tools.description: Emit a durable company event for trigger-based automation.

tools.name: company.events.list
tools.description: Read company event stream within tenant scope.

tools.name: company.artifact.evaluate
tools.description: Run/store QA evaluation for a deliverable before downstream execution.

tools.name: company.handoff.accept
tools.description: Accept an artifact handoff assigned to the receiving member/agent.

tools.name: company.artifact.materialize
tools.description: Materialize an inline artifact into the controlled tenant workspace after policy/QA checks.

tools.name: company.agent.messages.list
tools.description: Read persistent internal message traffic available in tenant scope.

tools.name: company.repositories.list
tools.description: List repositories available to the current tenant identity.

tools.name: company.delivery.create
tools.description: Create a repository delivery run from an immutable Artifact Registry bundle.

tools.name: company.delivery.prepare
tools.description: Materialize bundle artifacts into an isolated Git worktree and create the Commit Agent commit + patch artifact.

tools.name: company.delivery.tests
tools.description: Run the delivery pipeline test profile against the isolated worktree.

tools.name: company.delivery.review
tools.description: Submit an identity-bound human/AI code review decision.

tools.name: company.delivery.merge
tools.description: Merge a delivery only after test and review gates pass and repository permission allows it.

tools.name: company.delivery.rollback
tools.description: Revert a merged delivery using the controlled repository rollback agent.

tools.name: company.workspaces.list
tools.description: List controlled development workspaces available to the current tenant identity.

tools.name: company.workspace.create
tools.description: Provision a tenant-bounded development workspace or detached repository worktree.

tools.name: company.sandbox.run
tools.description: Execute an argv command inside a policy-bound sandbox profile with optional short-lived secret grants.

tools.name: company.releases.list
tools.description: List immutable commit-pinned releases for the current organization.

tools.name: company.release.create
tools.description: Create a release from a verified Git commit or merged repository delivery.

tools.name: company.release.deploy
tools.description: Deploy a release through environment policy and approval gates.

tools.name: company.deployment.rollback
tools.description: Rollback an environment to the previous successful deployment lineage.

tools.name: company.handoff.trigger_delivery
tools.description: Evaluate delivery automation rules for an accepted artifact handoff and create repository delivery runs.

tools.name: company.workspace.gateway.open
tools.description: Open an identity-bound provider-neutral workspace session for an AI employee.

tools.name: company.workspace.gateway.write
tools.description: Write a text file inside the bounded development workspace without repository credentials.

tools.name: company.workspace.gateway.read
tools.description: Read a bounded workspace text file through the audited Workspace Gateway.

tools.name: company.workspace.gateway.snapshot
tools.description: Snapshot workspace source into versioned Artifact Registry entries for downstream handoff.

tools.name: company.cicd.run
tools.description: Execute a versioned CI/CD DAG against an immutable Git commit.

tools.name: company.security.review
tools.description: Run the deterministic source security reviewer and persist findings.

tools.name: company.release_manager.assess
tools.description: Evaluate CI, security, approval and deployment evidence for release promotion.

tools.name: company.engineering.initiative.run
tools.description: Advance a Nina-governed engineering initiative through CI, evidence, security, release and deployment gates.

tools.name: company.runner.lease
tools.description: Acquire a capability-matched, time-bounded remote runner lease for an AI workload.

tools.name: company.runner.job.create
tools.description: Enqueue a workload for the runner node bound to an active lease.

tools.name: company.workload_identity.token
tools.description: Issue a short-lived workload JWT bound to an active runner lease and explicit scopes.

tools.name: company.supply_chain.sign
tools.description: Sign a digest-bound build evidence artifact using a configured signer reference.

tools.name: company.security.scan.external
tools.description: Run a configured deterministic/SAST/CVE scanner adapter against an immutable repository commit.

tools.name: company.telemetry.emit
tools.description: Emit a tenant-bound deployment or release telemetry sample for SLO evaluation.

tools.name: company.canary.run
tools.description: Execute persisted canary traffic steps and halt/rollback on SLO breach.

tools.name: company.incident.create
tools.description: Open an auditable operational incident visible to Nina and human operators.

tools.name: company.portfolio.review
tools.description: Ask Nina's deterministic portfolio layer to summarize engineering delivery health and recommendations.

tools.name: company.runner.trust.certificates
tools.description: Inspect active/revoked runner client certificate identities without exposing private keys.

tools.name: company.workload_identity.jwks
tools.description: Read tenant workload identity public signing keys during controlled key rotation.

tools.name: company.supply_chain.verify
tools.description: Verify signed build evidence against a tenant trust policy before release promotion.

tools.name: company.telemetry.otlp.emit
tools.description: Ingest OTLP JSON metric points with tenant/release attribution for SLO evaluation.

tools.name: company.secret.lease
tools.description: Request a short-lived secret access lease; plaintext secret values are never returned by this API.

tools.name: company.incident.page
tools.description: Queue governed incident paging through configured console/webhook routes.

tools.name: company.sre.plan
tools.description: Have Nina create a deterministic recovery plan with risk/approval gating for an incident.

tools.name: company.sre.execute
tools.description: Execute an approved SRE recovery run; critical actions cannot bypass approval unless authorized admin force is used.

tools.name: company.team.create
tools.description: Create an agent team, optionally spanning companies, with a coordination mode.

tools.name: company.team.roster
tools.description: List agent teams and their members with roles and turn order.

tools.name: company.room.open
tools.description: Open a collaboration room for a team with a turn mode and max turn budget.

tools.name: company.room.read
tools.description: Read a room, its seats and its append-only transcript.

tools.name: company.room.speak
tools.description: Post a turn. Rejected if it is not the caller's turn or the turn type needs decision rights.

tools.name: company.room.close
tools.description: Close a room and optionally publish its summary into the knowledge mesh.

tools.name: company.delegation.propose
tools.description: Propose a delegation contract with objective, acceptance criteria, deadline and cost ceiling.

tools.name: company.delegation.respond
tools.description: Accept a proposed delegation contract as the assignee.

tools.name: company.delegation.list
tools.description: List delegation contracts with their state machine status.

tools.name: company.knowledge_mesh.search
tools.description: Search shared knowledge as a specific member; results are filtered by effective permission and every attempt is logged.

tools.name: company.knowledge_mesh.contribute
tools.description: Contribute a versioned entry to a knowledge space the caller may write to.

tools.name: company.knowledge_mesh.permission
tools.description: Resolve the effective permission a member has on a knowledge space.

tools.name: company.collaboration.summary
tools.description: Summary of teams, open rooms, delegation states and mesh activity.

tools.name: company.org.create_company
tools.description: Stand up a new company in the organization. Rejects duplicate names.

tools.name: company.org.create_department
tools.description: Create a department under a company, optionally with a head member.

tools.name: company.org.create_member
tools.description: Add a human seat, or an agent seat plus its openclaw runtime binding.

tools.name: company.org.move_member
tools.description: Reassign a seat's company, department, manager, role or status. Reporting cycles are rejected.

tools.name: company.work.create_project
tools.description: Open a project for a company with an optional owner.

tools.name: company.work.update_project
tools.description: Update project status, progress, owner or description.

tools.name: company.work.create_task
tools.description: File a task on a project. New tasks always start in backlog.

tools.name: company.work.move_task
tools.description: Move a task along a legal transition. Skipping review is rejected.

tools.name: company.work.assign_task
tools.description: Assign or unassign a task. Inactive members cannot receive work.

tools.name: company.work.vocabulary
tools.description: Read allowed statuses, priorities and legal task transitions before attempting a write.

tools.name: company.runtime.protocol
tools.description: Read which OpenClaw gateway contract this deployment speaks, plus the legacy-to-upstream method map.

tools.name: company.runtime.health
tools.description: Check the OpenClaw gateway connection before dispatching work.

tools.name: company.runtime.gateway_agents
tools.description: List the agents the OpenClaw gateway actually has configured.

tools.name: company.runtime.seats
tools.description: List company agent seats and the OpenClaw agentId each one is bound to.

tools.name: company.runtime.reconcile
tools.description: Compare company agent seats with the gateway roster and flag drift. Seats whose agent is gone become 'detached'; nothing is deleted.

tools.name: company.runtime.bind_seat
tools.description: Bind a company agent seat to an existing OpenClaw agentId. OpenClaw agents are created by the operator with `openclaw agents add`.

tools.name: company.runtime.start_task
tools.description: Send a task to its agent's own OpenClaw session (agent:<id>:company-task-<task>) and move it to in_progress.

tools.name: company.runtime.abort_task
tools.description: Abort the running OpenClaw session for a task and park the task back on the board.

tools.name: company.runtime.transcript
tools.description: Read the chat history of the OpenClaw session behind a task.

tools.name: company.runtime.streams
tools.description: List OpenClaw session followers running in this API process, plus whether auto-dispatch is on.

tools.name: company.runtime.follow_task
tools.description: Keep a task's OpenClaw session subscription open so its events, status changes and approval prompts are recorded.

tools.name: company.runtime.unfollow_task
tools.description: Stop following a task's OpenClaw session in this process.

tools.name: company.runtime.task_events
tools.description: Read the persisted runtime events recorded for a task's OpenClaw session.

tools.name: company.board.move_task
tools.description: Move a task on the board and, for agent-owned work entering in_progress, dispatch and follow it automatically.

tools.name: company.runtime.approvals
tools.description: List approval rows created from OpenClaw gateway permission prompts.

tools.name: company.runtime.leases
tools.description: Show which backend owns session-follow leases (redis or process memory) and which sessions this process holds.

tools.name: company.runtime.resumable
tools.description: List tasks that are mid-run with an OpenClaw session but currently unobserved, e.g. after a restart.

tools.name: company.runtime.resume
tools.description: Re-attach session followers for in-flight tasks. Lease-guarded, so it is safe to call from every worker.

tools.name: company.approvals.readiness
tools.description: Check whether an approval decided in ClawCompany can actually be delivered to the OpenClaw gateway.

tools.name: company.approvals.decide
tools.description: Approve or deny an OpenClaw permission prompt from the company queue; reports recorded and delivered separately.

tools.name: company.runtime.registry
tools.description: Report whether run reporting is shared across workers and whether the orphan-takeover sweep is enabled.

tools.name: company.runtime.orphans
tools.description: List mid-run sessions that currently have no lease holder, i.e. nobody is recording their events.

tools.name: company.runtime.claim
tools.description: Take over unattended OpenClaw sessions. Lease-guarded: one worker wins, the rest are declined.

tools.name: company.runtime.cluster_streams
tools.description: List session followers reported by every API worker. Reports process_local=true when the view covers this process only.

tools.name: company.runtime.gaps
tools.description: List unattended OpenClaw sessions and how long they went unobserved. Missed events are never replayed.

tools.name: company.approvals.backfill_readiness
tools.description: Report whether exec.approval.list can be called: needs the operator.approvals scope and a native runtime.

tools.name: company.approvals.backfill
tools.description: Pull approval prompts the gateway raised while no follower was attached into the company queue. Idempotent.

tools.name: company.runtime.reconcile_status
tools.description: Report automatic reconciliation passes made by this API worker, plus whether approval listing is possible. History is process-local.

tools.name: company.runtime.reconcile_session
tools.description: Force a reconciliation pass for one task's OpenClaw session: record the observation gap and pull pending approval prompts. Bypasses the cooldown.

tools.name: company.runtime.fabric_status
tools.description: One answer for this worker's shared Redis fabric: pool state, lease store, stream registry, reconcile ledger, and whether they agree with each other.

tools.name: company.runtime.index_health
tools.description: Lease and registry index-set health. Reading it also prunes members whose key has already expired.

tools.name: company.runtime.fabric_reconnect
tools.description: Skip the reconnect backoff and dial Redis now, after an outage has been fixed.

tools.name: company.project.truth
tools.description: Progress derived from the task board, the stored column, and the drift between them.

tools.name: company.project.progress_sync
tools.description: Write the board-derived progress onto the project; no-op when nothing is measurable.

tools.name: company.project.archive_preview
tools.description: What archiving this project would cancel, and any live OpenClaw session blocking it.

tools.name: company.project.archive
tools.description: Archive a project by cancelling the work it still owed. Nothing is deleted.

tools.name: company.task.guarded_move
tools.description: Move a task only if expected_revision still matches, so a stale read cannot overwrite newer work.

tools.name: company.board.guards
tools.description: List entities and fields that accept a guarded (compare-and-set) write.

tools.name: company.project.guarded_update
tools.description: Update a project only if its revision is unchanged; the database enforces it.

tools.name: company.task.guarded_update
tools.description: Update task fields under a binding revision guard (does not apply status transition rules).

tools.name: company.company.guarded_update
tools.description: Update a company under a binding revision guard.

tools.name: company.department.guarded_update
tools.description: Update a department under a binding revision guard.

tools.name: company.member.guarded_update
tools.description: Update a member under a binding revision guard.

tools.name: company.project.restore_preview
tools.description: Show what un-archiving a project would restore and what it would skip.

tools.name: company.project.restore
tools.description: Reverse an archive, reopening the tasks that archive cancelled.

tools.name: company.project.board_history
tools.description: Derived progress, archive preview and restore state for one project.

tools.name: company.archive.vocabulary
tools.description: Which entities the cascade archive can touch and which status words it writes.

tools.name: company.company.archive_preview
tools.description: Blast radius of archiving a company: departments, members, projects, live sessions.

tools.name: company.company.archive
tools.description: Archive a company and cascade to its departments, members and open projects.

tools.name: company.company.restore_preview
tools.description: What un-archiving a company would restore, and which prior states are known.

tools.name: company.company.restore
tools.description: Un-archive a company, returning each row to its recorded prior state.

tools.name: company.department.archive_preview
tools.description: Blast radius of archiving a department, including live OpenClaw sessions.

tools.name: company.department.archive
tools.description: Archive a department: lock its access level and offboard its members.

tools.name: company.department.restore_preview
tools.description: What un-archiving a department would restore.

tools.name: company.department.restore
tools.description: Un-archive a department and reinstate the members it offboarded.

tools.name: company.member.archive_preview
tools.description: Blast radius of offboarding a member, including agents and live sessions.

tools.name: company.member.archive
tools.description: Offboard a member; agent rows stay registered and live sessions are reported.

tools.name: company.member.restore_preview
tools.description: What reinstating a member would restore.

tools.name: company.member.restore
tools.description: Reinstate an offboarded member at the status recorded at archive time.

tools.name: company.audit.feed
tools.description: Write audit feed: guarded writes, lost races, archives and restores.

tools.name: company.audit.entity
tools.description: Audit trail for one row: who changed it, when, and which fields moved.

tools.name: company.revision.modes
tools.description: Which entity kinds carry an exact revision counter and which fall back to timestamps.

tools.name: company.revision.read
tools.description: Read a row's revision token, legacy token, and whether a guarded write would be exact.

tools.name: company.row.guarded_update
tools.description: Compare-and-set on any guarded entity using a counter or timestamp revision token.

tools.name: company.audit.page
tools.description: Paged write audit feed; pass next_cursor back as cursor to walk history.

tools.name: company.company.projects_restore_preview
tools.description: Which projects a company archive cancelled and which would reopen in a batch restore.

tools.name: company.company.projects_restore
tools.description: Reopen every project cancelled by a company archive, each through the v28 project restore.

tools.name: company.fields.vocabulary
tools.description: Department statuses, clearable columns, and the clear sentinel used by guarded writes.

tools.name: company.fields.history
tools.description: Per-field value timeline for one row, rebuilt from recorded before-values.

tools.name: company.department.update
tools.description: Edit a department name, head, access level or status; names are unique per company.

tools.name: company.department.name_conflicts
tools.description: Duplicate department names in a company, which block migration 0014.

tools.name: company.project.set_owner
tools.description: Assign a project owner, or unassign one with clear_owner true.

tools.name: company.audit.coverage
tools.description: Which write paths record before-values, plus the retention and revision-adoption policies. Read this before claiming a field history is complete.

tools.name: company.events.retention_preview
tools.description: Events a prune would delete, by tier, and which undo records are protected because their row is still archived.

tools.name: company.events.prune
tools.description: Delete expired company events. dry_run defaults to true; admin role required for human callers.

tools.name: company.revision.adoption_preview
tools.description: Rows still guarded by a timestamp instead of an exact counter, and how many are old enough to adopt one safely.

tools.name: company.revision.backfill
tools.description: Adopt a revision counter of 1 for rows older than the quiet period. Never renumbers a row that already has one. dry_run defaults to true.

tools.name: company.runtime.pool
tools.description: Shared Redis pool state and the exponential backoff schedule.

tools.name: company.runtime.metrics
tools.description: Prometheus text exposition for the lease store and Redis pool.

tools.name: company.member.runtime_orphans
tools.description: Tasks still holding a dead runtime session after a member restore.

tools.name: company.member.runtime_resume_plan
tools.description: The dispatch calls that would restart parked work. Never executed here.

tools.name: company.member.runtime_park
tools.description: Drop dead session keys so the board stops claiming a runner exists. Dry run by default.

tools.name: company.progress.drift
tools.description: Where typed project progress disagrees with the task board.

tools.name: company.progress.sync
tools.description: Write derived progress onto drifted projects. Dry run by default.

tools.name: company.knowledge.retrieve
tools.description: Ranked retrieval over readable knowledge spaces (keyword, semantic or hybrid).

tools.name: company.knowledge.retrieval_quality
tools.description: What the hash384 ranker is and is not good at.

tools.name: company.runtime.lease_index
tools.description: Lease index size plus a dry-run prune preview.

tools.name: company.runtime.lease_index_prune
tools.description: Remove index members whose lease key is gone. Bounded, dry run by default.

tools.name: company.recovery.coverage
tools.description: What v33 repairs and what it deliberately leaves alone.

tools.name: company.events.backlog
tools.description: List company events whose trigger side effects never ran (status pending/error, older than the quiet window).

tools.name: company.events.detail
tools.description: Read one company event with its payload to decide whether replaying it is safe.

tools.name: company.events.replay
tools.description: Re-run the trigger pass for stuck company events. Dry run by default; admin floor because trigger actions write.

tools.name: company.events.runtime_unmirrored
tools.description: Runtime events stored on disk whose run never produced a company event.

tools.name: company.events.runtime_reemit
tools.description: Put specific runtime events back on the company bus. Never re-meters usage.

tools.name: company.progress.schedules
tools.description: List scheduled project progress sync operations and whether they have ever fired.

tools.name: company.progress.schedule_create
tools.description: Register a cron schedule that runs the project progress drift sweep. Manager floor.

tools.name: company.progress.schedule_toggle
tools.description: Enable or disable a progress sync schedule and recompute its next run.

tools.name: company.grants.ledger
tools.description: Standing OpenClaw grants with review deadlines. Expiry is recorded locally, never enforced on the gateway.

tools.name: company.grants.due
tools.description: Standing grants already expired or expiring soon, with the session keys an operator must clear by hand.

tools.name: company.grants.revoke
tools.description: Close a standing grant ledger row after an operator clears it on the gateway host. Admin floor.

tools.name: company.replay.coverage
tools.description: What v34 repairs and where each piece stops: replay scope, scheduler readiness, grant expiry enforcement.

tools.name: company.spend.coverage
tools.description: Where v35 stops: how delegation spend is attributed and what the SSE live channel does not do.

tools.name: company.spend.report
tools.description: Delegation contracts with budget, attributable spend and status (within/warning/over/unbudgeted/unattributable).

tools.name: company.spend.rollup
tools.description: Organization level budget vs spend totals for delegation contracts.

tools.name: company.spend.overruns
tools.description: Delegation contracts that burned past max_cost_usd, optionally including warnings at 80 percent.

tools.name: company.spend.detail
tools.description: One delegation contract with the usage_events rows behind its attributed spend.

tools.name: company.spend.flag_overruns
tools.description: Emit one delegation.budget.overrun event per contract over budget. Dry run by default, never blocks work, admin only.

tools.name: company.live.readiness
tools.description: Transport and limits of the live channel: SSE, server still polls, no websocket.

tools.name: company.live.snapshot
tools.description: One renderable frame: recent runtime events, live tasks, followers, cursor to stream from.

tools.name: company.live.events
tools.description: Cursor based catch-up of runtime events for clients that cannot hold an SSE connection.

tools.name: company.live.tasks
tools.description: Tasks currently in_progress or review, with their runtime run and session keys.

tools.name: company.live.stream
tools.description: Server-sent event stream of runtime events for one organization. Closes itself and returns a cursor to reconnect with.
